name: acne-step0-miss-trace
note: Stage trace of Step0 on the frozen layer-1 TARGET points (AI engineering labels, not ground truth). Nearness (box centre within r = 0.03 fw) only follows a target between stages; found/missed stays the frozen one-to-one result.

coordinateCheck.predictions: final boxes in source px of the product input file (native tiles, scale 1); trace finals equal the stored infer-step0 rows on 28/28 photos
coordinateCheck.labels: layer-1 points in source px of the same file (sha256 checked)
coordinateCheck.faceWidth: |landmark 234 - landmark 454| in source px (normalised landmarks x source width/height); identical to layer-1 faceWidthPx on 28/28
coordinateCheck.tests: tests/unit/test_acne_step0_trace.py: tile-local->source mapping and clipping, tile coverage margin >= 48 px, staging filter (src - origin) * scale mapping and unchanged accepted coordinates: 3/3 pass

environment: device python 3.10 venv: torch 1.12.1+cpu, torchvision 0.13.1+cpu, numpy 1.26.4, opencv-headless 4.12.0, scikit-image 0.25.2; 2 threads
